_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Using have for age (I have 20 years)
mistake.vi: Nói tuổi bằng have: "I have 20 years" (tiếng Tây Ban Nha: tengo 20 años)

segments.text: Don't say, I have twenty years. Say, I am twenty years old.
In English, we use be for age, not have.
Repeat after me. I am twenty years old.
Now ask a friend. How old are you?

native.caption: En inglés la edad va con “be”, no con “have”: “I am 20 years old”. Nada de “I have 20 years” 🙅 Repite después de Carlos y practica más gramática en la app Lexkite.

en.caption: In English, age goes with “be”, not with “have”: “I am 20 years old”. Never “I have 20 years”. Repeat after Carlos and practice more grammar in the Lexkite app.
